findings.title: §5.1 names the wrong path for validateDuelSnapshot
findings.claim: §5.1 places `validateDuelSnapshot` in net/snapshot.ts. That file does not exist. The function and the `roundAt`/`interiorAt` offsets it changes are in sim/duel/snapshot.ts. That slice also already binds a local `helm` (the round module's Helm player), which sits next to the new `helmAt` name.
findings.evidence: spec L167 ('validateDuelSnapshot (net/snapshot.ts)'). src/renderer/src/sim/duel/snapshot.ts:L106 (validateDuelSnapshot), L128 (roundAt, interiorAt = roundAt + 4), L145 (`const [round, helm, base, decided] = values.slice(roundAt, interiorAt)`). codec.ts:L109 also points to sim/duel/snapshot.ts.
findings.why: A fresh subagent looking for net/snapshot.ts finds nothing. The L145 slice must become `slice(roundAt, helmAt)`, or the round tuple picks up the throttle. A grep finds both quickly, so this is a nit.
findings.fix: Change the path to sim/duel/snapshot.ts. Add that the round tuple at L145 now slices `roundAt..helmAt` and the throttle is `values[helmAt]`.

prior.note: §5.5 (L216-218) now predicts with `{ turn: pair.axes.turn, thrust: throttleThrust(d.throttle) }`, which is not circular: scripted.ts:L92 calls hazardAway(d, pair.axes) before deciding. §5.3 (L196-199) already covers axes(), the online replica source and the telemetry rule.

§5.1 L164-169 names the module, its order, field, kinds and reasons, and now the snapshot offsets `helmAt = roundAt + 4; interiorAt = helmAt + 1` with an integer −1..4 check. That matches snapshot.ts:L128 (interiorAt = roundAt + 4 today). §5.2 L173-181 covers DUEL_KINDS, check order and noop. The only remaining issue is the file path (new P3).

§5.2 L183-186 adds throttle to net/contracts.ts and to duelWire.commands as a strict z.object with `level: z.number().finite()`, so the sim answers a bad level `malformed`. This fits codec.ts:L110-121 (a closed strict list). The no-redeploy note and step-1 placement are both stated, and §8 L326 adds a codec round trip.

§6.2 L280-284 limits clear() to Tab, restart and blur, as in input.ts:L59-62. clearUi() handles console changes and leaves physical keys alone. L275-276 says a repeat keydown never counts fireDown, which is consistent with input.ts:L52 (`!e.repeat`). §7 L305 and §8 L313-315 are updated to match.
§6.1 L251-253 defines `HeldFlags` inline as new in app/duel/input.ts, filled from the last merged KeySample, with ConsoleView's held fields as picks of it.

verified: Codec: duelWire.commands is a closed list of strict objects (src/renderer/src/net/codec.ts:L110-121), so the §5.2 Wire paragraph (spec L183-186) is necessary and sufficient on the codec side.

Snapshot offsets: today interiorAt = roundAt + 4 (sim/duel/snapshot.ts:L128) and length is checked against interiorAt + interiorCount (L129). Inserting helmAt = roundAt + 4 and interiorAt = helmAt + 1 (spec L167) is consistent with that, and with the helm module placed after round in DUEL_MODULES (spec L164).

Scripted prediction: hazardAway(d, axes) is called with pair.axes before the pair decides (scripted.ts:L74, L92). Using pair.axes.turn with throttleThrust(d.throttle) (spec L217) has a defined value at call time.

Keyboard: today's keydown adds repeats to held and counts presses only on !repeat (input.ts:L50-52). keyup counts fireUp only if Space is held (L56). clear runs on blur (L62). The §6.2 split (L280-284) and the repeat rule (L275-276) keep today's keyboard behaviour.
§7 (L305) and §8 (L313-315, L326) agree with the revised §6.2 and §5.1/§5.2. I found no contradiction with the unchanged §5.3-§5.6.
not_verified: net/contracts.ts's wire DuelCommand union (cited in the round-2 finding at L74-76): I did not re-open it this round.
Whether step.ts's running result helper can take a `noop` status without touching the other modules' result streams: step.ts is outside the touched regions and was not re-read.
